{{Quote|''Instigator'', this is Ree Shala. I have come to warn you of an impending attack on this planet by Mahk'khar. His vessels are in orbit on the other side of Galaan. I thought this information might put me better, ahem, standing with the New Republic.|Ree Shala cons the crew of the ''Instigator''|<ref name="Relic (article)" />}}
'''Ree Shala''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lady]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] who bought the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Jaresh/Legends|Jaresh]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and set up her floating [[Ree Shala's Base|base]] there. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], she had outgrown it and was hired by the mysterious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Durrei]]. He ordered Shala to assault a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] communications center of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Galaan/Legends|Galaan]]. While she attacked it with her fellow crime lord [[Mahk'khar]], a group of New Republic operatives investigating a [[Kashi Mer talisman|relic]] sought by Durrei entered the battle and made both flee. 

==Biography==
===Corva sector crime lady===
[[File:Ree Shala Base.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ree Shala used a base (pictured) on the moon Jaresh.]]
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Ree Shala began her career as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] on the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] lanes in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and spent many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] doing so. Following many successful enterprises, she decided to create an organization where she set up the dealings and others did her work for her. The [[Gender/Legends|woman]] pooled together&mdash;over some years&mdash;a mid-sized organization in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva Sector]]. Shala based her group on [[Jaresh/Legends|Jaresh]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Jaresh system/Legends|Jaresh system]] she had purchased<ref name="Relic (article)" /> around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Relic (article)|Relic]]" is dated to the time shortly after [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo's]] defeat at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]], which occurs in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The base floated above the moon's ground and featured her quarters and a single [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] for a small vessel, which she arranged so her followers could land around the base and walk to it.<ref name="Relic (article)" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Shala had four other bases, but had outgrown her Jaresh base and abandoned it, leaving behind the [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[AC1 surveillance droid]] she had modified herself. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lady]] was also contacted by the mysterious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Durrei]], a user of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. He proposed that her organization work for him, permanently, and offered a large sum sign-on bonus to entice her. She agreed and her first assignment was to attack a hidden [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] communications center on [[Galaan/Legends|Galaan]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Galaanus system]].<ref name="Relic (article)" />

===Assault on Galaan===
{{Quote|Cyptology has decoded the files. According to this information, Mahk'khar sold the device to&hellip; &hellip;to Ree Shala, a known smuggler in this sector. Her organization has recently begun to expand. Apparently, she offers greater cuts to her ''employees''.|Captain Naren Bluuis|<ref name="Relic (article)" />}}
[[File:Mahkkhar-Journal8.png|thumb|left|200px|Ree Shala attacked the communications center with Mahk'khar (pictured), who had produced false information on her.]]
Around that time, Durrei had also procured the services of the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mahk'khar]] in finding an ancient [[Kashi Mer talisman|relic]] of the [[Kashi Mer]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. After finding out New Republic intelligence knew of his deed, Mahk'kahr planted misinformation at his [[Mahk'khar's Palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuulab]] identifying Shala as the new owner of the relic. The Gotal was then ordered by Durrei to attack the communications center with Shala, though she was not named to him.<ref name="Relic (article)" />

Shortly after the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]], a crew of New Republic operatives began investigating the relic and found the information, later decoded by New Republic cryptology and presented at a briefing by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naren Bluuis]]. The operatives were provided coordinates to her abandoned base, where they found a broken [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] on Galaan.<ref name="Relic (article)" />

Shala and Mahk'khar, the former in her stolen [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] ''[[Striker (assault shuttle)|Striker]]'', began their assault on the communication center. When the New Republic crew joined the battle in their [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ship]] ''[[Instigator/Legends|Instigator]]'', both of the criminals fled, though the Striker had a damaged [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], forcing Shala to stay in orbit on another side of Galaan. The crew encountered the Twi'lek while leaving the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and she attempted to con the crew to stall them as the ''Striker''{{'s}} crew made repairs. She hailed the ''Instigator''{{'s}} comm channel and warned them that Mahk'khar was about to attack Galaan. Shala dealt with the crew and was able to get safe passage from the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. In return, the woman revealed the Gotal planned to sell the relic in the [[Jandoon system/Legends|Jandoon system]]. In ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], the Striker{{'s}} hyperdrive was repaired and Shala jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to find a deserted area in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to plan her next move.<ref name="Relic (article)" />

==Personality and traits==
Shala had the masculine Twi'lek first name "Ree," which translated to [[Spear/Legends|spear]]. She also had the clan surname "Shala," which meant "crying, tearful."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ree Shala appeared in "[[Relic (article)|Relic]]," an article published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The article was written by [[George R. Strayton]] and artist [[Doug Shuler]] provided the illustration of the character.<ref name="Relic (article)" />

In the "[[Ask Lobot]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 115|one-hundred and fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, Keeper of the Holocron [[Leland Chee]] stated that the depictions of Twi'lek females with Human-like [[Ear/Legends|ears]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="Insider115">{{InsiderCite|115|Ask Lobot}}</ref> like Ree Shala's,<ref name="Relic (article)" /> were initially considered non-continuity, but considered the possibility they were the result of Human-Twi'lek crossbreeding.<ref name="Insider115" /> The issue was published on [[January 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=fans/medianews/news20100115.html|text=Mandos Are Here: ''Star Wars Insider'' #115}}</ref>
